text: I often feel like there aren't enough hours in the day to get everything done.
I find it difficult to fully disconnect from work or responsibilities during my free time.
I have healthy ways of dealing with stress, such as exercise, hobbies, or talking to someone.
I sometimes feel emotionally exhausted even after doing tasks that aren't physically demanding.
I feel a sense of accomplishment and purpose from my daily work or studies.
I have been feeling more cynical or detached from things I used to care about.
Physical symptoms like headaches, muscle tension, or stomach problems show up when I'm stressed.
I feel comfortable saying 'no' to extra responsibilities when my plate is already full.
I regularly take breaks and make time for activities that bring me joy.
I have been sleeping poorly or irregularly due to stress or overthinking.
I feel like I'm always rushing from one task to the next without a moment to breathe.
I find it hard to ask for help even when I'm clearly overwhelmed.
I feel that my personal life has suffered as a result of my workload or responsibilities.
I feel motivated and excited to start my day most mornings.
